payload.recallText: The narrator is a young student journalist who stumbles into a moral grey area when a simple campus prank involving a dean getting hit with a pie becomes his ticket to the spotlight. What starts as a harmless creative embellishment to make his articles stand out quickly snowballs into a full blown urban legend about a caped crusader called Pie Man. He watches from the sidelines as the campus falls in love with the character he basically invented, feeling a strange sense of ownership over the narrative. When a girl he has always had a crush on notices him and asks him if he is the man behind the legend, he cannot resist the temptation.
